title: CampaignCore
description: Allows the utilization of CampaignCore (Catbox Branch) music in Minecraft.
body:
CampaignCore utilizes catbox.moe to share music codes between players.

It features 3 commands.

/ccplay [code]

/ccstop

/ccvolume [0.0-1.0]


Please note that this allows you to play audio files not present in the native Minecraft files. You are subject to your own discretion when playing music codes given by other players.

Additional Notes:
- Audio files uploaded to Catbox must be in MP3 format or they will not work.
- Catbox going down will prevent you from hearing these files, check the websites up-status before complaining about the mod itself. It works, I tested it.
- "Music code" refers to the jarble of characters before ".mp3" in an uploaded Catbox file.
